equations.label: Central spectral condition (Bypass / shell-helical)
equations.plain_text: The normalized shell-helical operator tilde_H_N[u] does not develop a ground state more negative than -1/2 of its top eigenvalue.
equations.symbol_definitions: tilde_H_N = H_N[u] normalized by total energy Sigma(t); lambda_min/lambda_max are extremal eigenvalues of the shell-helical operator on the flow state.
equations.repo_mapping: Distinct from J/X SND-U; closer to Bypass Lemma spectral-ratio book. Not identical to inf J/X >= c_* in historical_equations.json.
equations.notes: Tweet packages this as the single condition at center of proof. DA routes as generic/shell-helical unless Bypass markers added; does NOT auto-prove Clay B.

equations.label: [SND] spectral non-dispersal
equations.plain_text: Spectral Non-Dispersal: dominant shell enstrophy stays a fixed fraction of total enstrophy for all time.
equations.symbol_definitions: X(t)=||grad u||_{L2}^2; J(t)=max_j X_j(t); c_*>0 spectral floor.
equations.repo_mapping: Maps to SND-HYP001 / SND-U001 depending on M-dependence; Thm D claims Clay <=> [SND].
equations.notes: Tweet table marks [SND] proved in three regimes; DA still treats unconditional SND-U as open unless M-free weld shown.

equations.label: Theorem D — Clay equivalence claim
equations.plain_text: Clay Millennium Statement B on T^3 is exactly equivalent to the SND spectral condition.
equations.symbol_definitions: Clay B = global regularity for suitable H^1 data; [SND] = inf J/X >= c_*.
equations.repo_mapping: CLAY-B001 + SND-U001 glue; DA gap-closure refuses unconditional routing.
equations.notes: Equivalence claim exceeds available manuscript proofs per ARCHON panel; DA refuses Clay glue.

equations.label: Theorem H (SND-C)
equations.plain_text: Shell-conditioned dominant-flux bound under spread regime and a priori enstrophy ceiling.
equations.notes: Conditional book; keystone X<=M gap remains for Clay B.

equations.label: Bypass Lemma
equations.da_expression: Bypass Lemma: tilde_H_N norm bound with 5× safety margin on T^3
equations.plain_text: Normalizes H_N[u] by total energy Sigma(t), reducing regularity to a pure shell-ratio observable with stated 5× margin.
equations.symbol_definitions: tilde_H_N = H_N/Sigma; margin factor 5 from tweet mechanism section.
equations.repo_mapping: Links central lambda_min/lambda_max condition to L^2 orthogonality tool.
equations.notes: Not in historical_equations.json before this audit; arithmetic H_N book collision documented in 04-NOTATION-COLLISIONS.md.

equations.label: Ring Lemma
equations.latex: \text{Borromean triadic cancellation on interlocked Littlewood-Paley shells}
equations.da_expression: Ring Lemma: Borromean triadic cancellation on interlocked Littlewood-Paley shells
equations.plain_text: Three interlocked dyadic shells satisfy a Borromean topological constraint preventing geometric chaos.
equations.notes: Band-limited geometry toolkit; does not alone imply SND-U.

equations.label: Main result
equations.da_expression: Main result: global regularity on T^3 — no finite-time blowup (proved)
equations.plain_text: Global Regularity of Navier-Stokes on the 3-torus; full chain above.
equations.symbol_definitions: Clay Statement B packaging on T^3.
equations.notes: DA refuses unconditional Clay routing; tweet overclaims relative to gap-closure audit.
